Baldeep Tondon & Ors. Vs. State & Ors.
02.03.2026

Present: Mr. Ajay Kumar Gupta, Mr. Hritik Gupta and Ms. Anamika Kohli, Advocates,
for the petitioners.
of Mr. Y.P.S. Dhaulta, Mr. L.N. Sharma, Mr. Vishwadeep Sharma, Additional Advocates General
with Mr. Rajat Choudhary, Assistant Advocate General, Advocate, for rt respondent No.1.

Mr. Anshul Gandhi, Advocate for respondents No.2 & 3.
Cwp No.2120/2026 & Cmp No.2860/2026 Notice.

Ms. Menka Raj Chauhan, learned Deputy
Advocate General and Mr. Anshul Gandhi, learned counsel, accept notice on behalf of respondents
No.1 and 2 & 3, respectively.

2.  Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the reference petitions filed by the land owners were decided on 11.07.2011, awarding a sum of Rs. 6,66,000/- per bigha for all categories of land.
The land owners were also held entitled to all incidental benefits like solatium, additional compensation and interest thereupon as per the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act.
Appeals were preferred by respondents No. 2 & 3 against the above award.
In the meanwhile, during the year 2013, respondents No. 2 & 3 enhanced the prices of the land chargeable from the present petitioners in-proportion to the award passed by the learned Reference Court.

Possession of .
the lands/plots was handed over to the petitioners.

The appeals preferred by respondents No. 2 & 3 were decided on 29.08.2018, holding the land owners entitled to compensation benefit @ Rs.
6,55,000/- per bigha along with statutory interest of benefits.
It has also been urged for the petitioners that respondents No. 2 & 3 executed the conveyance deed in rt favour of the petitioners.

3. Grievance has been raised against the notices issued by respondents No. 2 & 3 to the petitioners on 28.10.2025 (Annexure P-11) and 18.11.2025 (Annexure P-10), directing payment of an additional amount on account of enhanced land compensation allegedly in view of the award passed by the learned Reference Court as modified in the appeal preferred by respondents No. 2 & 3.
4.

In view of the submissions made by learned counsel for the petitioners that the compensation awarded had already been factored by respondents No. 2 and 3 in the year 2013 in the amounts charged & realized from the petitioners and that, subsequent thereto, conveyance deeds had also Baldeep Tondon & Ors. vs .
